title: Single-Molecule-Magnet Behavior in a [2 × 2] Grid DyIII4 Cluster and a Dysprosium-Doped YIII Cluster

synthesis.procedure: Hbpt (0.1 mmol, 0.023 g) and MeCN (8 mL) were added to a 23 mL Teflon-lined reactor and dissolved by an ultrasonic bath for 10 min at room temperature. Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 0.045 g) was added, and the solution was heated at 160 °C for 72 h, then cooled to room temperature at 5 °C/h. Colorless blocklike crystals along with white amorphous powder were obtained. Products were washed with analytically pure MeCN three times and collected by filtration; pure colorless crystals were manually separated under a microscope. Acetate ligands arise from in situ MeCN hydrolysis.
synthesis.temperature: ultrasonication at room temperature, then 160 °C; cooled at 5 °C/h
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: washed with MeCN three times, filtered; colorless block crystals manually separated from white amorphous powder under a microscope

properties.summary: Complex 1 is a [2 × 2] Dy4 SMM with two zero-field slow-relaxation processes attributed mainly to single-ion Dy behavior. χMT at 300 K is close to four free DyIII ions; weak ferromagnetic interactions appear at low T. Dual Arrhenius barriers Ueff1 = 93(3) cm−1 (FR) and Ueff2 = 143(15) cm−1 (SR) under zero dc field; 1500 Oe data are nearly identical. The SR barrier was described as the highest among pure Dy4 SMMs at the time.

measurements.conditions: zero dc field Arrhenius fit of thermally activated τ; τ1 = 4.07 × 10−9 s

measurements.name: Ueff2 (slow relaxation)
measurements.conditions: zero dc field Arrhenius fit; τ2 = 2.85 × 10−9 s

material_class.structural_family: isostructural [2 × 2] square-grid tetranuclear cluster; magnetically dilute Dy-doped Y4

synthesis.procedure: Magnetically dilute Dy@Y4 was obtained by combining accurately measured Dy(NO3)3·6H2O and Y(NO3)3·6H2O in a 1:19 molar ratio, following the solvothermal procedure described for 1 (Hbpt/MeCN, 23 mL Teflon-lined reactor, 160 °C, 72 h). The resulting doped ratio is 1:16 (nonstoichiometric) rather than the 1:19 feed. DyIII content in 2 is 6% by ICP.

reagents.name: 3,5-bis(pyridin-2-yl)-1,2,4-triazole (Hbpt)
reagents.amount: same procedure as 1 (0.1 mmol, 0.023 g in the parent synthesis)

reagents.name: dysprosium(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: combined with Y salt in 1:19 molar ratio

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: same isolation as 1; bulk purity checked by PXRD vs single-crystal calculation (Figure S1)

properties.summary: ac magnetometry of dilute 2 shows two slow-relaxation processes similar to 1, supporting a single-ion Dy origin. Cole–Cole α = 0.09–0.28 (11–15 K). Arrhenius fits above 5 K give Ueff1 = 86(6) cm−1 (FR) and Ueff2 = 117(8) cm−1 (SR). Barriers and τ0 differ modestly from 1, ascribed to subtle geometry changes and vanishing Dy–Dy exchange upon dilution; low-T τ is nonlinear due to competing relaxation.
